template: Prohibition on source-of-income discrimination in housing applies to this address. Source: Cal. Gov. Code § 12955(a), (c), (p); as of 2027-07-02. Not legal advice.
rewrite:
At this address, housing decisions can't be based on where a person's income comes from (for example, their source of income). Source: Cal. Gov. Code § 12955(a), (c), (p); as of 2027-07-02.

Not legal advice.
